bagPolicy.summary: Gas South Arena enforces a clear bag policy to ensure effective and contactless screening. All bags will be checked, and guests must pass through a metal detector.
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions and have designated screening areas.

parking.note: Parking rates vary by event, with non-event rates starting at $5 and event day parking at $15. Valet parking is available for $40, but may not be offered for all events. Prepaying for parking is recommended to save time and ensure a spot.

rideshare.note: Pick-Up: Guests utilizing shuttle services, personal pickup or Rideshare such as UBER or Lyft will be allowed to pick up on Arena Drive near the surface lots in front of the Arena. Drop-Off: Guests using drop-off service transportation vehicles, including other ride-sharing services such as Uber and Lyft, may drop off near the front of Gas South District.

concessions.note: Gas South Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including pizza, hot dogs, cheesesteaks, and Mexican food. Beverages include Coca-Cola products and a selection of beers. The venue is cashless, accepting only card payments or specific gift cards.
stands: Gas South Convention Center's Food Hall

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Assistive listening devices are available for select performances. The Arena has accessible seating located in all levels of the Arena at all price categories.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exiting and re-entering the building with the same ticket is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Arena events, the Ticket Office opens 1 hour prior to doors for ticket purchases for that specific event. For Theater events, the Ticket Office opens 1 hour prior to the event for ticket purchases for that specific event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Gas South Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
